title: SkyrimNet Brothel
tagline: Prompt for the player's answers in SkyrimNet Brothel.
description: Prompt used by SkyrimNet Brothel's built-in copy of Player Choices: writes a customer's line and the player's replies to it (or the player's opening lines), each following what the brothel says the reply must mean, in the player's own manner. Requires that mod.
author: nightlantern-mods
